use_prepare_proto_hook: use the PrepareProtoBeforeValLoopHook to regenerate prototype vectors before validation in mmpretrain retrievers
register_hook_module: register the PrepareProtoBeforeValLoopHook with HOOKS registry for automatic prototype preparation during validation
call_before_val_method: call the before_val method on PrepareProtoBeforeValLoopHook to prepare prototypes before the validation loop
check_base_retriever: check if the model is a BaseRetriever instance before calling prepare_prototype in the hook
unwrap_model_wrapper: unwrap the model using is_model_wrapper before accessing the underlying BaseRetriever in the hook
